<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Judicial oversight of ECI:</strong> Beyond the SIR challenge, the Supreme Court has reprimanded the Election Commission for failing to produce 2023 Sringeri assembly vote-counting footage, warning of potential adverse inferences.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W9</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W8</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Political discourse on governance:</strong> Opposition leaders, including Akhilesh Yadav, have accused the BJP of colluding with the Election Commission to manipulate electoral processes, while internal debates continue regarding state-level welfare schemes and caste census demands.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W17</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W18</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W24</a></span></li>
</ul>
